responseMessageContents.text:
The user encountered a 404 error on GitHub when trying to access a release page for a private repository. They were able to see the releases earlier when logged in, but the direct download link they're trying to open in a new browser session doesn't have authentication, so GitHub returns a 404 instead of showing the private repo.

However, I'm noticing something odd — the API call to fetch the latest release worked without authentication, and the download link returned a 200 status code, which suggests the repo might actually be public. The 404 could mean the repo was renamed, made private after they initially accessed it, or the URL they're visiting is incorrect. I should verify the current status of the repository to figure out what's actually happening.

responseMessageContents.text: There's a discrepancy between what the system says (new empty project) and what the filesystem actually shows (an existing project with full history). I've already verified the server returns 200 for everything, so the repo is publicly accessible. The 404 the owner saw on their phone could stem from being logged out, a truncated URL, or some other client-side issue rather than an actual server error.

That screen is GitHub's standard **404 "Not Found" page** — it means the specific URL your browser opened doesn't exist or wasn't visible to your session at that moment. It is **not** an error with your app, your release, or your data.

I re-verified everything live from production just now (01:42 UTC) — all links are up:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Repo `github.com/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` | HTTP 200 ✅ |
| Releases page | HTTP 200 ✅ |
| Release `v1.4.5-build37` page | HTTP 200 ✅ |
| APK download (84,842,092 bytes, correct Android MIME) | HTTP 200 ✅ |

**Most likely causes of the 404 you saw:**
1. **Truncated/altered URL** — your browser's address bar shows the repo name cut off (`rork-global-real...`); if the link was copied incompletely or a character was added, GitHub returns 404
2. **Logged-out session mid-navigation** — you were viewing the Releases page logged in earlier; if the mobile browser dropped the session on a private page, GitHub shows 404 instead of 403
3. **A momentary GitHub glitch** — the page is confirmed live now

**What to do:** open this exact link fresh (copy it whole):

```
https://github.com/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/releases/download/v1.4.5-build37/ivx-holdings-v1.4.5-build37-final.apk
```

That downloads the latest APK (v1.4.5 Build 37, 84.8 MB) directly — no GitHub page navigation needed. If you prefer to browse, the releases page itself is also live: `https://github.com/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/releases`

If it 404s again on your phone, tell me and I'll mirror the APK to the public `app-releases` bucket (like the v1.4.1 link that worked for you) so you have a GitHub-independent download.
